subcategory_text: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle
implementation_examples: Protect all components of organization-developed software from tampering and unauthorized access
Secure all software produced by the organization, with minimal vulnerabilities in their releases
Maintain the software used in production environments, and securely dispose of software once it is no longer needed
assessment_objectives: Determine whether secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle.
Determine whether activities are conducted to protect all components of organization-developed software from tampering and unauthorized access.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that secure all software produced by the organization, with minimal vulnerabilities in their releases.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
